hero.title: Jamila Sultan Medical & Dental Centre (JSMDC)
hero.desc: Providing free and highly subsidized OPD consultations, dental procedures, maternal care, and life-saving medicines to deserving families in Korangi, Karachi.

departments.title: Clinical Departments & OPD Services
departments.subtitle: Equipped with modern medical equipment and compassionate doctors.

opd.title: General Outpatient (OPD)
opd.desc: Daily medical consultations by senior physicians for acute and chronic conditions.

dental.title: Dental Care & Dental X-Ray Clinic
dental.desc: Full dental cleanings, extractions, fillings, root canals, dental X-ray imaging, and oral surgery — fully registered & compliant with Sindh Health Care Commission (SHCC).

gynecology.title: Gynecology & Maternal Care
gynecology.desc: Prenatal care, postnatal checkups, routine screening, and women's health counseling.

ent.title: ENT Clinic
ent.desc: Comprehensive ear, nose, and throat care including hearing tests, sinus treatment, and surgical procedures.

chest.title: Chest Clinic
chest.desc: Specialized respiratory care for asthma, COPD, tuberculosis, and other pulmonary conditions.

eye.title: Eye Clinic
eye.desc: Complete ophthalmology services including vision testing, cataract screening, and eye surgery.

mother_and_child.title: Mother & Child Clinic
mother_and_child.desc: Comprehensive maternal and pediatric healthcare including antenatal care, immunizations, and child wellness checkups.

family_planning.title: Family Planning Clinic
family_planning.desc: Counseling and services for family planning, reproductive health, and maternal wellness.

pharmacy.title: Free Medicine Pharmacy
pharmacy.desc: Full dispensing of prescribed medications completely free for deserving patients.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic Ultrasound & X-Ray
diagnostic.desc: Subsidized diagnostic imaging and fast turnaround report delivery.

gallery.title: OPD Clinic Services in Action
gallery.desc: Real photos from our multi-specialty OPD consultation rooms at JSMDC.

zakat.title: No Deserving Patient Left Untreated
zakat.desc: At JSMDC, financial constraint should never prevent anyone from getting quality care. Deserving patients receive consultation, diagnosis, and full course of prescription medicines free of charge through Zakat & Sadqah funds.
